samples.xml_description:
<module id="LIFObuffer">
    <description>A Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) buffer for temporary data storage. This 4-bit wide buffer can hold up to 4 entries, allowing for push and pop operations controlled by read/write (RW) signals.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="dataIn" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit input data to be pushed onto the buffer.</input>
        <input id="RW">Read/Write control signal (1 for read, 0 for write).</input>
        <input id="EN">Enable signal to activate buffer operations.</input>
        <input id="Rst">Active high reset signal to initialize the buffer.</input>
        <input id="Clk">Clock signal for synchronous operations.</input>
        <output id="EMPTY">Flag indicating whether the buffer is empty.</output>
        <output id="FULL">Flag indicating whether the buffer is full.</output>
        <output id="dataOut" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit output data retrieved from the buffer.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Buffer implementation goes here...</implementation>
</module>
